english.title: Fail to comply with / do an act in contravention of closure order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with, or did an act in contravention of, a closure order issued under Schedule 2 to the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013 in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE NON-COMPLIANCE / CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 9(1)(b) and (6) of Schedule 2 to the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
failed to comply with / did an act
in contravention of a closure order

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence should be used in circumstances other than where a person has permitted a premises to be open in contravention of a closure order. In those cases H10950 should be used.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with, or did an act in contravention of, a closure order issued under Schedule 2 to the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF THE NON-COMPLIANCE OR CONTRAVENTION..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
